panels.title: Section 1: Trade Aggression Features - Normalized Imbalances

targets.query:
from(bucket: "feature_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "FEATURE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ta_vol_imbalance_ratio_1s" or r._field == "ta_vol_imbalance_ratio_3s" or r._field == "ta_vol_imbalance_ratio_5s")
